name: Synaptic
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow package-manager behavior: Synaptic compares downloaded package hashes against the apt Packages metadata before accepting the package; the trust root is apt's signed repository metadata/keyring.
limitations: This application delegates payload verification to PackageKit/Flatpak/snapd/apt backends; the external backend version and active keyring are outside this checkout.
This evidence does not establish a complete primary self-updater classification.
